newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Digital's Hungary unit turnover up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Digital's Hungary unit turnover up 40 pct.

text.p: The Hungarian unit of U.S.'s Digital Equipment Corporation increased its turnover by 40 percent to 5.5 billion forints in their financial year ending June 30 compared to the previous year, a company official said on Wednesday.
"In an otherwise stagnant domestic computer market, we think this is a remarkable result," general director Gyorgy Beck told a news conference.

He added that Digital Equipment Magyarorszag Kft last year changed the focus of its business towards telecommunications, commerce and services, away from their former main client base in state administration and the financial sector.
In the telecommunications sector, MATAV and the two mobile services operators are among Digital's stable and strong partners, Beck said.

The company's key product remains the 64-bit Alpha Server and complimentary equipment, but in the future -- as customer demand becomes clearer -- it will concentrate more on providing integrated systems, Beck said.
